text_block_list.text:
Today is the Spring Fan Fest, and plenty
of
activities are being held for fans to
enjoy.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: What's wrong, Ticket?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Waaaaah! Help me, Hayahideee!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит
choice_data_list: You seem to be in a bind...

text_block_list.text: I am! I'm in a huge bind, and I need Hayahide's help!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Уиннинг Тикит is nearly
incomprehensible in her
distress, so we
follow her to find out what's going
on.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It's time for the brain strain trivia game!
Make
some noise, everyone! We're
about to find out
who will receive the
Trivia Crown!
text_block_list.name: Inari One

text_block_list.text: Uh, what?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Why, if it isn't Бива Хаяхидэ. Were you
entered
into this unwittingly as well?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: A-actually, yes...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry. But we do sincerely
appreciate an
Umamusume of your
stature joining the
proceedings.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
There were some issues with the
equipment for
the event planned for this
time slot, so a trivia
show was created to
fill the gap.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I see... So that's why Ticket was so
desperate for
my help.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
It's just a little diversion until the
equipment is
repaired. There's nothing
to it, so let's take it
easy and enjoy
ourselves, shall we?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: You've got this, Prez!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
First question! How many courses have a
turf
track with a height difference of
three me—
text_block_list.name: Inari One

text_block_list.text: Ping!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Five. The courses with a height
difference of three
meters or more are
Nakayama, Kyoto, Chukyo,
Kokura, and
Hakodate.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
That's... correct! The question was, "How
many
courses have a turf track with a
height difference
of three meters or
more?" And the answer is five!
text_block_list.name: Inari One

text_block_list.text: Wow! You're amazing!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Now, now, Teio. Audience
members must
remain in their seats.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Yes, ma'am!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
(Who's the one who said we should "take
this
easy" again? She's obviously playing
to win!)
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Rudolf is incredible! Come on, Hayahide!
You can
do it!
text_block_list.name: Fan
Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Hayahideee! You can do it! Look, I
brought some
support!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
I came like you asked and she saw me...
So can I
leave now?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: (Brian?! What's she doing here?)
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Aw, come on! She needs our support!
Let's cheer
for her together! Ready,
and...
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: You can do it, Hayahideee!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
What incredibly loud cheering... Oh, is
that Brian?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Question number two! How long is the
To—
text_block_list.name: Inari One

text_block_list.text: Ping!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
525.9 meters. If you're asking about the
length of
the track at Tokyo Racecourse,
that is.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Correct! The answer is indeed 525
meters!
Hayahide's not to be outdone
with that
lightning-fast answer!
text_block_list.name: Inari One

text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Sigh... I can't believe you dragged me into this, Ticket.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
The battle for the Trivia Crown rages on
until,
finally, a winner is decided.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And the winner of the Trivia Crown is...
President
Rudolf!
text_block_list.name: Inari One

text_block_list.text: Yaaay! I knew you'd win, Prez!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you're too much, Teio. Don't you
need to
prepare for the next event?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Sigh...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Thank you... But if I'd only gotten one
more
question right...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Hmph...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Sigh... I can't believe you dragged me into this, Ticket.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
The battle for the Trivia Crown rages on
until,
finally, a winner is decided.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And the winner of the Trivia Crown is...
Biwa
Hayahide!
text_block_list.name: Inari One

text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
text_block_list.name: Spectators

text_block_list.text:
Hehe! I couldn't have done it without
everyone
rooting for me.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Hayahide, you nailed it! And thanks sooooo much for agreeing to join!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Goodness... Just so you know, the next
time
you're in trouble, I won't agree to
help before I
squeeze every last detail
out of you!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Also, um...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Are you by yourself right now?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: I sure am!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Hmm, I see...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: But! Brian was with me until just a little while ago!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
I saw her kinda smile a little when you
won!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Hehe. That's nice to hear.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Бива Хаяхидэ's face glows with a
bashful smile.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Бива Хаяхидэ looks frustrated and just
a touch
fatigued as she lets out another
sigh.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
